action: The ground cracks glow amber, the ghost horde rises around the centre: pret figures unfold upward, krasue heads float in circles with their light trails, krahang flap their basket wings, prai women wail, smoke and ash swirl, then the horde fades back into the smoke. Keep the same palette and style, transparent background.
